reportable.description: Never 'no'. A wrong yes costs an FSO five minutes; a wrong no is a reporting violation.

voluntary.description: True when the user chose to disclose a matter the tables did not require. Treated identically downstream, and noted in the package because prompt good-faith disclosure is a recognized mitigating consideration.

basis.description: Matched table entry IDs from corpus/reporting/tables/

layers_applied.description: SEAD 3 applies to every covered individual regardless of population. ISL 2021-02 applies to cleared industry only.
